scripts.ios: node scripts/sync-web.mjs && npx cap sync ios && npx cap open ios
scripts.android: node scripts/sync-web.mjs && npx cap sync android && npx cap open android
scripts.android:debug: node scripts/sync-web.mjs && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.android:release: node scripts/sync-web.mjs && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
